## Empowering Appalachia Through Artificial&nbsp;Intelligence

The Appalachian A.I. Corps is an initiative dedicated to empowering Appalachian communities to harness artificial intelligence technologies to support their region, communities, and families.

We believe that the power of AI should be accessible to all. Through education, collaboration, and practical application, we're building a future where Appalachian communities lead in the intelligent use of technology.

[Explore Our Modules](modules){.btn}
:::

<!-- ========================= -->
<!-- SUPABASE + AUTH SCRIPTS   -->
<!-- ========================= -->

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<script src="js/supabase-config.js"></script>
<script src="js/utils.js"></script>
<script src="js/auth.js"></script> <!-- your existing auth file -->

<!-- ========================= -->
<!-- NAVBAR LOGIN / DROPDOWN   -->
<!-- ========================= -->

<script>
(async () => {
  const session = await getSession();

  if (session) {
    const { data: profile } = await _supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("username, role")
      .eq("id", session.user.id)
      .single();

    if (profile) {
      // Show dashboard link
      document.getElementById("dashboard-link").style.display = "inline";

      // Replace Get Started with dropdown
      const authButton = document.getElementById("auth-button");
      authButton.innerHTML = `
        | <div class="dropdown">
            <button class="btn btn-light btn-sm dropdown-toggle" onclick="toggleUserMenu()">
              Welcome back, ${profile.username}
            </button>
            <div id="user-menu" class="dropdown-menu">
              <a href="dashboard">Dashboard</a>
              <a href="#" onclick="handleLogout()">Log Out</a>
            </div>
          </div>
      `;
    }
  }
})();

function toggleUserMenu() {
  const menu = document.getElementById("user-menu");
  menu.classList.toggle("show");
}
</script>
